[NERR.2.1] The `detail` string is owned by libds (or is a static literal).
**Treat it as valid only until your next call into libds on the same engine.**
Copy it before the next call if you must retain it (alerting pipeline, log
forwarder). A call that acts on no engine, such as a `ds_json_*` call or a
`ds_engine_new` that fails, returns a detail valid for the life of the process
([IERR.4.1.1]).
